newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian capital bans smoking in public places.
newsitem.headline: Indian capital bans smoking in public places.

text.p: Smoking will be banned in public places in New Delhi from January 26, India's Republic Day, the Press Trust of India reported on Friday.

The news agency said the ban by the capital's Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party administration will cover government offices, educational institutions, hospital buildings, cinemas, restaurants and public transport.
India is the third largest tobacco producer in the world. About 85 per cent of its tobacco is consumed in the domestic market.
